one_line_description: Brex offers an API for integrating with its finance and fintech services, including expense management, payments, and accounting. It supports OAuth2 for authentication and provides a public API for developers to build custom workflows.
auth_notes: Developer authentication requires creating a token with specific scopes and passing it in API call headers.

evidence.quote_snippet: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.

The endpoint is https://api.brex.com/mcp, it supports OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration so most clients connect without any manual token setup, and it exposes more than 50 tools across expenses, cards, banking, bills, travel, and accounting.
